featured_reviews.name: Soma Kar Guru
featured_reviews.review_text:
I Came by " The Stitch Story" by chance and this by chance became no less to a platinum deal to me.

I have no qualms about a  fact that I know nothing on Fashion.
What matters to me is Comfort and Sustainability.
" The Stitch Story " to me is Fashion,Comfort and Simple Accountability.
I have been so influenced by her pieces.
She urges me to think,to think on and about the  environment,my existence and my responsibility,my potential and my love.

A close look at her page and a splurge of time on to her creations will surely explain the free feel I experience.
The detailing,the hues,the fabric,the design ,the cut, the connect to Earth ,all.of it take me to the journey like a follower.

I wear and flaunt and enjoy the shower of compliments.

Not to miss there are POCKETS too🥰

I wish the earth better days and ways ,and with people like you I ma sure and hopeful.
You are just the ONE.
Very proud of you🩵

featured_reviews.name: Mrunal Kotwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience with The Stitch Story by Natasha! Her designs are elegant, with incredible attention to detail.

What truly stood out for me was her transparency and genuine care. It felt less like a transaction and more like a creative collaboration. That trust and connection made all the difference. She even suggested what pattern would suit me, the final outfits were very comfortable, beautifully made and just made me happy :)

Highly recommend her shop to anyone looking for thoughtful, handcrafted pieces!

featured_reviews.name: Shampa Roy
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fabulous experience with The Stitch Story. Not only do they customize, they make sure that the client is going to get exactly what they want. To that end, they seek information and share images so that the final order is just what has been envisioned by the client, in terms of fabric and aesthetics. The final product has always been deeply gratifying. It's wonderful to see traditional Indian embroideries and textiles made available to the modern wardrobe, with such ease and care.

featured_reviews.name: Anjana Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a wonderful experience shopping with the stitch story. Natasha personally helps with selecting the design and customising it. My kurta was made to fit yet relaxed, exactly the way I wanted. From making to packing, there’s a personal touch, an artistic finish. Keep growing Natasha 👍🏻

featured_reviews.name: Rishika Sunkara
featured_reviews.review_text: I purchased a customised dress from The Stitch Story. The quality of the fabric is so good and comfortable. They have really elegant and fun designs. I highly recommend it to anyone who is looking for beautiful handmade clothes!

featured_reviews.name: padma rao
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently got this kurta customised from The stitch story . The fit is perfect and the fabric feels so good on the skin and the design is exactly the same as discussed . I have been a loyal customer of the stitch story for many years now . I highly recommend buying from them

featured_reviews.name: Charu Razdan
featured_reviews.review_text: The Stitch Story has been an amazingly unique experience. I was first taken in by their photography, which highlighted the little details in their designs. Then I explored their style book and found a subtle design aesthetic, which was really different from other brands. The fine needlework, the rich colours and fabrics, and the little personal touches - like sending swatches of the materials used in your dress so you know what you’re wearing and how to care for it - impressed me. Interacting with Natasha over the past few months has been a joy; she has been so warm and attentive from day one. Super happy to have found these guys! Wish you great luck, Stitch Story team, continue to do the fabulous work you do!

featured_reviews.name: Subha Hari
featured_reviews.review_text: I love buying clothes from The Stitch Story. They use excellent quality fabric, their designs are unique and I particularly love the beautiful handmade touches they add to every dress. The icing on the cake is their wonderful after sales service and their willingness to customize the size to fit. I highly, highly recommend The Stitch Story to anyone looking for clothes that are elegant, non fussy and sustainable in every sense of the word.

featured_reviews.name: anumeha verma
featured_reviews.review_text: Dress collection is good. Still need to add more stock in relation to colors and fabric. Worst was the service here. I bought a birthday dress that jas tail. Paid for it 2 days ago and came today to collect it. At the time of making the purchase I noticed the threads were loose for the hooks added on the frock and tail. I asked them to fix it and I will collect it two days later. Inspite of telling the guy at the billing counter to make a note of this in the bill he didn’t quoting, the sales guy will manage. Today when I come to collect it, the work was not done!!! The billing guy obviously didn’t remember the work that was required and the sales guy who sold the item “apparently “ moved to another store. Precisely why I was emphasizing to the guy at the billing counter to write it somewhere. But he didn’t and result - the work was not done. The finishing of the threads loosened out were not checked before handing it over. I had to stand there and get it done as I had spent 400rs to travel back and forth to collect it. Extremely poor service. The staff needs to be trained to check the items from their end for any issue before handing it over to the customer.

featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience at this kids wear store. The quality of the clothes is excellent, and the designs are trendy and stylish. They had no shame that there were customers who were looking at the products. One should not talk about personal matters around them. One should work during working hours.

1) 2 Black dress staff sitting there applying their nail paint but don't have time to help the client with makeup products.

2) When I asked for a lipstick shade, she replied very very rudely.Is this the right way to work? If you don't want to work then sit at home, why are you ruining the brand's name.

The main purpose of complaining is that the higher authority should pay attention to what is happening at the ground level.

It was a very bad experience.....

featured_reviews.review_text: Very cool and comfy shoes for men and kids. Clothes are also great. Must visit once !!! 😍

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Westside in Borivali, and it was honestly such a lovely shopping experience. The store has a very calm and classy vibe, and everything is neatly arranged, which makes browsing really enjoyable.

I found some beautiful outfits that were stylish yet comfortable, and the quality felt really good for the price. Their collection is modern and perfect for both casual wear and special occasions. The staff was polite and helpful, giving space to explore while being available when needed.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Lakhani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolute rubbish place. placed an order for an outfit on a Sunday evening, had agreement for trial and fit for Tuesday. This got delayed until Wednesday. Went to see the product, and the item was made incorrectly, with completely wrong sleeve finish and buttons. Kamlesh, the owner, said that they would change it and would try and get it to us on Wednesday evening, or by Thursday morning latest.mno courtesy call received on Wednesday evening to say they were not coming. Thursday I called at 12.30,'staff assured me item was ready and delivery would leave by 1pm, to arrive at 2. Called at 2pm, still had not left. Called again at 2.30, not left, staff lying to me saying he was leaving now. Called at 3, still not left. Called at 3.30, staff still lying. Finally arrived after 4.30 pm - checked the product, 2 big oil marks on the front chest, stain marks all over the item - the bottoms looked like someone had poured muddy water on them, so many stain marks - and there was a tear in them!! clearly quality control was not on their agenda!
Travelled from andheri west to borivali, another 1.5hrs wasted - was so annoyed at this point wanted refund - kamlesh just doesn't listen, talks over, cuts your off - started trying to take marks out with his nails and scratched the velvet material - went to get it cleaned, still rubbish, sent it back again and had new bottoms made. Finally delivered at 11.30pm that night - even then, the stupid delivery driver wanted us to walk 10 minutes to meet him at a mall - after all the trouble they could not even have the customer service to the door. New bottoms (cream colour) have a big red stain, but what can we do now?
Finally, saw the receipt and Kamlesh had deceitfully converted the currency exchange rate at point of sale, adding another 8% cost for myself to the bill because of the bad exchange rate - without even telling me!
Kamlesh you are nothing but a thief, and I recommend all to avoid this shop, very unprofessional - better to pay a bit more and go to bigger more professional shop.
Pathetic excuse for a shop, avoid like the plague.
